decision: Retain the existing opt-in weighted spectral search. No further codec change accepted in this pass.
limits: Existing development recordings, not fresh held-out validation. PESQ/ESTOI diagnostics only; no listener result. Trials were scored through the software decoder; only the existing candidate had expanded hardware testing.

gain.description: After weighted shape search, subtract 0.25, 0.5 or 1 times the weighted mean shape error from target gain, then requantize b2.

joint.description: Include quantized gain error in shape search; update gain after each of two coordinate-descent passes.

asymmetric.description: Two coordinate-descent passes minimize sum weight*(2**(compression*shape_error)-1)**2, compression 0.125 or 0.25, to penalize amplitude overshoot more strongly.

interpolation.description: Decoder trial 1 falls back to windowed oscillators if either endpoint harmonic frequency reaches Nyquist; trial 2 falls back when the harmonic is absent from either frame. Hardware-encoded and weighted-software-encoded streams evaluated separately.

from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out=root/'build/dstar-pitch/interpolation'; out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
s='#include <stdlib.h>\n'+(root/'src/decoder/mbelib.c').read_text()
needle='            if (use_interpolation) {'
assert s.count(needle)==1
s=s.replace(needle,'''            const char* trial = getenv("MBE_TRIAL_INTERPOLATION");
            if (trial && atoi(trial) == 1 && (cw0l >= (float)M_PI || pw0l >= (float)M_PI)) use_interpolation = 0;
            if (trial && atoi(trial) == 2 && (l > cur_mp->L || l > prev_mp->L)) use_interpolation = 0;
'''+needle)
(out/'mbelib.c').write_text(s)
(out/'CMakeLists.txt').write_text((root/'build/dstar-pitch/decoder/CMakeLists.txt').read_text().replace('dstar_decoder_experiment','dstar_interpolation_trial'))

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(dstar_gain_trial LANGUAGES C CXX)
get_filename_component(MBELIB_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(MBELIB_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MBELIB_BUILD_TOOLS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MBELIB_BUILD_BENCH OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MBELIB_DSTAR_WEIGHTED_QUANTIZER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${MBELIB_ROOT}" library)
get_target_property(codec_sources mbelib SOURCES)
list(REMOVE_ITEM codec_sources src/encoder/ambe_quant.cpp src/encoder/dstar_quantizer.cpp)
list(APPEND codec_sources "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ambe_quant.cpp" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/dstar_quantizer.cpp")
set_property(TARGET mbelib PROPERTY SOURCES "${codec_sources}")
